paragraphs.text: In spring, many songbirds begin singing before sunrise, producing a burst of sound known as the dawn chorus. Although the phenomenon is familiar, scientists still disagree about why it happens at this particular time of day.
paragraphs.label: A

paragraphs.text: One explanation concerns sound. In the early morning the air is usually calm and cool, and some researchers argue that song travels further then than at any other time. However, measurements in several forests have found only small differences in how far sound carries.
paragraphs.label: B

paragraphs.text: A second idea is that dawn is simply a poor time for feeding. Insects are less active in the cold, and low light makes food hard to find, so birds may use the time for singing instead. Birds given extra food the evening before have been observed to sing earlier and for longer the next morning.
paragraphs.label: C

paragraphs.text: Singing may also be a way of showing strength. A male that has survived a cold night and still has the energy to sing loudly is sending a message to rivals and to females. This would explain why singing is most intense in the breeding season.
paragraphs.label: D

paragraphs.text: Artificial light may be changing the chorus. In several European cities, birds living near street lamps begin singing earlier than those in darker areas, although it is not yet clear whether this affects their breeding success.
paragraphs.label: E

items.quote: A male that has survived a cold night and still has the energy to sing loudly is sending a message to rivals and to females
items.prompt: a suggestion that singing gives information about a bird’s physical condition

explanation.en: Loud singing after a cold night shows the bird’s strength: “still has the energy to sing loudly is sending a message” → D. “Physical condition” = “strength”, “energy”.
explanation.kk: Суық түннен кейін қатты сайрау құстың күшін көрсетеді: «still has the energy to sing loudly is sending a message» → D. «Physical condition» = «strength», «energy».
explanation.ru: Громкое пение после холодной ночи показывает силу птицы: «still has the energy to sing loudly is sending a message» → D. «Physical condition» = «strength», «energy».

items.quote: measurements in several forests have found only small differences in how far sound carries
items.prompt: research that did not fully support one theory

explanation.en: The idea that sound carries further at dawn was not fully supported: “measurements … have found only small differences” → B. The experiment in C supports its theory instead.
explanation.kk: Таңертең дыбыс алысқа жетеді деген теория толық расталмаған: «measurements … have found only small differences» → B. C абзацындағы тәжірибе, керісінше, теорияны қолдайды.
explanation.ru: Теория о том, что звук утром разносится дальше, не подтвердилась полностью: «measurements … have found only small differences» → B. Опыт в абзаце C теорию, наоборот, поддерживает.

items.quote: birds living near street lamps begin singing earlier than those in darker areas
items.prompt: a human influence on the timing of bird song

explanation.en: Street lamps are a human influence: “birds living near street lamps begin singing earlier” → E. “Timing” = singing earlier.
explanation.kk: Көше шамдары — адамның әсері: «birds living near street lamps begin singing earlier» → E. «Timing» — ертерек сайрайды дегені.
explanation.ru: Уличные фонари — влияние человека: «birds living near street lamps begin singing earlier» → E. «Timing» = поют раньше.

items.quote: Birds given extra food the evening before have been observed to sing earlier and for longer
items.prompt: an experiment in which the birds’ food supply was changed

explanation.en: “Birds given extra food the evening before have been observed to sing earlier” — their food supply was changed → C.
explanation.kk: «Birds given extra food the evening before have been observed to sing earlier» — құстарға қосымша жем берілген → C.
explanation.ru: «Birds given extra food the evening before have been observed to sing earlier» — птицам давали дополнительный корм → C.

items.quote: scientists still disagree about why it happens at this particular time of day
items.prompt: a mention of continuing disagreement among scientists

explanation.en: The first paragraph says scientists are still arguing: “scientists still disagree about why it happens”. “Continuing” renders “still” → A.
explanation.kk: Бірінші абзацта ғалымдар әлі күнге дейін келіспейтіні айтылған: «scientists still disagree about why it happens». «Continuing» сөзі «still» дегенді береді → A.
explanation.ru: В первом абзаце сказано, что учёные до сих пор спорят: «scientists still disagree about why it happens». «Continuing» передаёт «still» → A.

groups.instruction: Questions 1–5. The reading passage has five paragraphs, A–E. Which paragraph contains the following information? Write the correct letter, A–E.
